policy.revision: Terminal escape gives no credit for unearned fear. Earlier v1 pilot is excluded; normal manual campaigns unaffected.
policy.horizon: one revealed turn plus explicit asset/resource values
policy.random_penalty: Expected direct C/P cost across visible living targets; no actual target queried
policy.guard_plans: All useful incoming-hit allocations, plus one no-hit shield to expose legal activity reset
policy.limits: A heuristic control policy, not a full-run optimizer or evidence of human preference. Fixed before control runs.
